Don’t waste your time and money
Dec 2024 • Couples
This place is also know Bai Sao 1, and let me advice you that after visiting Vietnam for more than 5 weeks now this is the worst culinary experience and service we have had during our journey.

Got to be the worst food ever, nothing like it’s described on the menu, we ordered chicken pizza, described as having torn chicken in the description, instead a substandard pizza with chicken sausage bits all over it. Tasteless and nasty.
Our other order was fried eggs with a fresh bread roll, eggs totally undercooked and the fresh bread roll turned out to be two slices of rubbish stale bread. 
The staff are rude and some are even aggressive they wanted us to pay as they bought the unsavoury food to the table (I wonder why that was)unlike most resorts in Vietnam you don’t have to pay for the beach beds when you eat and drink in their bar. This place told us the beds would be free if we ate there however once we had the beds they insisted we pay for them extra. 
Please, please, please be aware this is a rubbish place
